_provenance: Condition registry, branch newdata-fix (2026-10-21). New clip-log experiment only: curtains CLOSED (CC), Setup1 + Setup2 pooled, no Outer speakers, no male phonemes (not recorded). One mount, fit on physical pink noise (pn_s12_mono_cc), applied to every other condition. Output goes to a FRESH folder (newdata_fix_output) so no cache from the first/second pass -- whose trial alignment was shifted -- is reused. `only` = folder must contain ALL substrings; `exclude` = drop if it contains ANY. The July conditions (gt_cave, gt_anechoic, vbap, vbap_gtmount) live on main / legacy-output-redirect.

pn_s12_mono_cc._note: MOUNT SOURCE. Physical speakers, pink noise, Setup1 + Setup2 pooled (36 positions = 12 az x 3 el). One rigid-rotation mount for the whole study: with correct trial alignment the two setups agree to ~1.5 deg and the mount is unchanged 9/13 -> 10/2, so no per-rig mounts. tol_deg 30 keeps every position in the fit/statistics (the physical el-0 speakers read ~10-15 deg low in elevation -- a real measurement to report, not an outlier to hide).

pn_s12_vbap_cc._note: VBAP pink noise, Setup1 + Setup2 grids (10/2 takes), scored under the PHYSICAL mount so any error is rendering error (the July 'vbap_gtmount' logic). The 9/13 takes (Pink_Noise_VBAP_Setup*_CC) are complete recordings too -- they only looked truncated because the old aligner mapped them past the end of the WAV; see pn_s12_vbap_cc_0913.

pn_s12_vbap_cc_0913._note: Optional: the original 9/13 VBAP pink-noise takes (same grid as pn_s12_vbap_cc). Enable to check take-to-take repeatability.

fphon_s12_mono_cc._note: Physical speakers, female phonemes, Setup1 + Setup2. Per-trial analysis window from each phoneme's logged duration (0.32-0.53 s).

fphon_s12_vbap_cc._note: VBAP female phonemes, Setup1 + Setup2 grids, physical mount.

newstim_s12_mono_cc._note: Physical speakers: 250/1000/5000 Hz tones, phone ringing, applause (200 ms), Setup1 + Setup2. The 5000 Hz tone is analysed but excluded from statistics (MAX_RELIABLE_HZ): kr~4.5 is far past the first-order intensity model's validity.

newstim_s12_vbap_cc._note: VBAP versions of the five 200 ms stimuli, Setup1 + Setup2 grids, physical mount.
